answer: Mechanism: Ripple–Wharf Locality Tickets. Each agent must route a nonce-bearing timing probe through one registered wharf gateway and two lagoon anchors; the anchors verify a consistent RTT ripple fingerprint. The scarce resource is unique, geographically dispersed low-latency network vantage points, not money. A Sybil costs separate hardware, calibrated clocks, and stable distinct paths per identity; virtual copies share fingerprints and fail cross-anchor triangulation.
